components.css: .ds-card{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",system-ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;max-width:260px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--cx-sep,#dedede);border-radius:10px;background:var(--cx-card,#fff);color:var(--cx-label,#171717);transition:border-color 150ms ease}.ds-card:hover{border-color:var(--cx-label-3,#737373)}.ds-card h4{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4}.ds-card p{margin:12px 0 15px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--cx-label-2,#626262)}.ds-card-action{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",system-ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:var(--brand-action,#171717);color:var(--brand-on-action,#fff);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-card-action:hover{opacity:.84}.ds-card-action:active{opacity:.75}.ds-card-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cx-label,#171717);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Home task composer
components.description: Desktop shape preview. The original canvas and actual backend request remain in the app.
components.css: .ds-task{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",system-ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;max-width:660px;min-height:80px;padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--cx-sep,#dedede);border-radius:14px;background:var(--cx-card,#fff);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.035);transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}.ds-task:hover{border-color:var(--cx-label-3,#737373)}.ds-task:focus-within{border-color:var(--cx-label,#171717);box-shadow:0 3px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.065)}.ds-task textarea{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",system-ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;min-width:0;height:54px;padding:15px 4px 10px;resize:none;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;color:var(--cx-label,#171717);font-size:15px}.ds-task textarea::placeholder{color:var(--cx-label-2,#626262)}.ds-task-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px}.ds-task-choice{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text",system-ui,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;min-height:34px;padding:5px 8px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--cx-label-2,#626262);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-task-choice:hover{background:var(--system-subtle,#e8e8e8)}.ds-task-send{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;padding:8px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand-action,#171717);color:var(--brand-on-action,#fff);cursor:pointer}.ds-task-send svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;transform:rotate(-45deg)}.ds-task-send:hover{opacity:.84}.ds-task-send:active{opacity:.75}.ds-task-send:focus-visible,.ds-task-choice:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cx-label,#171717);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-task{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-task textarea{height:68px;font-size:16px}.ds-task-controls{justify-content:flex-end}.ds-task-choice,.ds-task-send{min-height:44px}.ds-task-send{width:44px;height:44px}}

narrative.overview:
Cypher's original monochrome binary identity gives a functional agent workspace a quiet, recognizable center. Neutral surfaces, restrained separators, system typography, and generous space around the home task composer make the work readable. The existing binary lens and brief opening signature supply the identity's motion.

The current rules are extracted from the final imported brand stylesheet and its component sources. They supersede earlier Grok, adjustable-accent, lavender, glass, and decorative-orbit directions. This document records the implemented local candidate; final correction verification was pending at documentation time. It does not declare production activation or provider readiness.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and dark surfaces with monochrome actions and visible keyboard focus.
Original PNG artwork in navigation and sign-in; unchanged BinaryLens and CipherIntro for motion.
Platform typography with existing optional conversation typefaces retained.
Compact navigation, a calm task entry, and persistent recovery and authorization states.

rules.name: The Original Asset Rule
rules.body: Use the original PNG bytes through the proportional image viewport; never redraw its lettering, distort it, recompress it, or substitute a generated logo.

rules.name: The Neutral Action Rule
rules.body: App-owned brand, selection, link, and action styling stays neutral in both appearances; a saved legacy accent must not restore blue or purple chrome.

rules.name: The Optional Typeface Rule
rules.body: System UI is the workspace default. Existing Inter and Georgia conversation choices remain preferences, not a replacement brand identity.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Animation, a catalog listing, an open consent page, and a screenshot never establish completed work or an authorized connection.

dos: Do use the final neutral palette in both light and dark surfaces, including connector chrome and navigation.
Do preserve the original logo bytes, proportions, and embedded Cipher lettering while using Cypher for product text.
Do use the existing binary animations with visibility and motion gates.
Do keep keyboard focus, task errors, drafts, real run state, and provider authorization recovery visible.
Do keep dialog actions reachable while long content scrolls.
donts: Don't restore blue, purple, lavender, or a user-selectable color accent to app-owned brand and controls.
Don't add a graph, invented orbital logo animation, or simulated task progress to the task workspace.
Don't make Inter a new default brand face or remove the existing conversation typeface options.
Don't label a service connected before the backend discovers its tools or treat Sign in as an Allow grant.
Don't claim production deployment, live provider execution, pixel fidelity, or performance superiority from local tests and synthetic captures.
